name: Synthetic Go

meters.label: Weekly credit pool
meters.hint: Billing page at synthetic.new/billing, or GET api.synthetic.new/v2/quotas with your API key

reset.rule: Never resets all at once. Every 202 minutes you get back 2% of the weekly limit, so a full refill from zero takes about a week.
stipulations: This is the only limit. Synthetic has no 5-hour or monthly window.
Requests spend credits at discounted per-model token rates, so expensive models drain the pool faster.
Fast mode runs requests up to 2x faster and spends the pool at 2x.
Infinite mode requests never count against the pool but run much slower. Only DeepSeek V4.1 Flash supports it.
The plan card lists Fast mode and Infinite mode, but a note on the pricing page says they are included only with Big or Bigger.
Synthetic doesn't publish the pool size in dollars or tokens for any tier.
The quota API reports percent remaining and the time and size of the next refill. Calling it doesn't use the pool (third-party report, unconfirmed).

resets.label: Usage Reset

count.rule: One per month on every plan.

resets.howTo: Use it from the billing page at synthetic.new/billing.
stipulations: Synthetic lists "1 Usage Reset/month" on every plan but doesn't explain what it restores or whether unused resets carry over.
The reset count and the button to spend it appear only on the billing page, not in the API (third-party report, unconfirmed).

overage: At the limit, wait for the pool to refill, spend your Usage Reset, or pay for extra usage at API pricing. Synthetic doesn't publish a cap on extra usage. Upgrading to a bigger tier is the other option.

how: One weekly credit pool that refills 2% every 202 minutes. There is no 5-hour or monthly window.
Priority access. Up to 5 concurrent Infinite mode requests.
ext: Every model is from another company: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro, gpt-oss-120b, Qwen3.8-27B, GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-5.3 (beta) and GLM-5.3-Flash. The Web Search API is included.

Claude Code: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.synthetic.new/anthropic and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN to your key. The guide suggests the aliases syn:large:vision (Kimi K3.1 Pro) and syn:small:text (GLM-4.7-Flash).
Official guides also cover OpenCode, Crush, GitHub Copilot, OpenClaw, Xcode and Octofriend. Other tools can use the OpenAI-compatible API.
quirks: The pricing page contradicts itself on whether Fast and Infinite mode work on this plan. Check the billing page before relying on them.
In Claude Code, set CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0 so the prompt cache isn't busted on every request.
Model aliases such as syn:large:vision can point to a different model later. Use a full model name if you need the same one.
